title: The dock, after
logline: The dock two weeks after: the chairs gone in, and on the planks, two pale rings where two cans stood. The sequence ends on the rings.

panels.composition: Dock planks in September light, close: two faint pale rings on the wood where two cans of beer sweated a fortnight ago, and nothing else — the chairs gone, the bay beyond, a gull's shadow crossing.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of weathered dock planks with two faint pale rings where cans once stood, a gull's shadow crossing, water beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Two rings on the planks. The sequence ends.
